scientific.integrity: An exact all-positive-diagonal distributional theorem for the published sign-sketch rank-one Hutch++ trace estimator. The proof uses sign conjugation and the Rademacher quadratic-form variance identity; finite enumeration checks do not establish the infinite statement.
limitations: One sign-sketch column; the original three-query algorithm corresponds to one residual probe.
Strictly positive diagonal matrices in the coordinate basis of the sign probes.
Exact arithmetic, independent fair signs, and no non-diagonal or Gaussian-sketch claim.
Broad deflation-induced variance increase and diagonal Hutchinson exactness are known; novelty is the exact sign-sketch distribution law.

title: Exact sketch-invariant law for rank-one Rademacher Hutch++ on diagonal matrices
